raw: You can activate your new card in the app under Cards → Activate, either by tapping the card against your phone or by scanning it with the camera. The app never asks you to type the full card number or PIN to activate. If you want to use the card before it is activated, you can already add it to Apple Pay or Google Pay.

Chinor Bank accounts are available to residents aged 16 or over of one of our 12 supported countries. You will need a passport or national ID card and a short selfie video to verify your identity in the app.

Chinor Bank accounts are available to residents aged 16 or over of one of our 12 supported countries. You will need a passport or national ID card and a short selfie video to verify your identity in the app.

You can use any ATM that accepts your card network. Withdrawals are free up to 2,500,000 UZS per month on Standard and 6,000,000 UZS on Plus; above that a 1.3 % fee applies, and some ATM operators add their own surcharge, shown on screen before you confirm. ATMs with no operator surcharge are marked in the app under Cards → ATMs near me.

You can set up automatic top-up in the app under Account → Auto top-up. Choose a balance threshold and an amount of at least 50,000 UZS; when your balance falls below the threshold, the top-up is taken from your linked card. Debit-card top-ups are free; credit-card top-ups carry a 1.1 % fee.

Cash deposited at a Chinor ATM is credited immediately, and cash deposited at a branch counter is credited by the end of the same business day. Chinor does not accept cheques, so a cheque cannot be credited. If a cash deposit is still missing after that time, a human agent can check it with the deposit receipt.

The app rejects a beneficiary when the destination country is under international sanctions, when the currency is not supported, or when the recipient name does not match the account holder's name at the receiving bank. Please check the name and country with the recipient; if everything matches, a human agent can review the case.

Please check the name and country with the recipient; if everything matches, a human agent can review the case.

A domestic transfer can be cancelled in the app only while its status is Scheduled; once it shows Sent it cannot be cancelled. An international (SWIFT) transfer can be recalled within 24 hours of sending for a 90,000 UZS recall fee, but recall is not guaranteed because the receiving bank must agree.

A replacement card is sent automatically, free of charge, 45 days before your card expires, to the address in your profile. Your current card keeps working until the last day of its expiry month. When the new card arrives, activate it in the app under Cards → Activate.

Chinor cards work in more than 180 countries wherever the Visa or Mastercard network is accepted, except in countries under international sanctions. If a merchant declines the card, the app shows the decline reason under the transaction.

Standard delivery takes 7 business days. Express delivery takes 2 business days and costs 45,000 UZS. The first physical card has no delivery fee on either plan.

You can link a Visa, Mastercard, UzCard or Humo card issued in your own name under Account → Top up → Add card, and use it for manual or automatic top-ups. Debit-card top-ups are free; credit-card top-ups carry a 1.1 % fee.

Please check in the app that the card is activated and not frozen, that the relevant toggle under Cards → Security (contactless, online, ATM, magnetic stripe) is switched on, and that your daily limit has not been reached. If a chip card fails at every terminal it is treated as damaged and replaced free of charge.

First check the merchant's trading name and location under the transaction in the app — it can differ from the shop name. If you still do not recognise it, freeze the card in the app and raise a dispute from the transaction screen (Transaction → Something wrong → Dispute) within 60 days of the statement date.

Chinor converts at the interbank mid-market rate, plus a 0.9 % weekend markup from Saturday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 and a 0.6 % fee above the Standard monthly allowance. If the merchant offered to charge you in your home currency and you accepted, the merchant's own rate applied (dynamic currency conversion), which Chinor cannot refund; always choose to pay in the local currency.

Please check the ATM location and time under the transaction in the app. If you did not make the withdrawal, freeze the card immediately, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22, and raise a dispute from the transaction screen within 60 days of the statement date.
You can view or change your 4-digit PIN in the app under Cards → Security → PIN after confirming your passcode and biometrics. There is no fee, and the new PIN works from the next chip transaction.

Freeze the card now in the app under Cards → Freeze (or call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22), then cancel it and order a replacement; the first replacement each calendar year is free. Dispute any transaction you do not recognise from the transaction screen within 60 days of the statement date.

Chinor accounts are available to residents of 12 countries: Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkey, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Germany, Poland, the United Arab Emirates and the United Kingdom. Cards can be used in more than 180 countries, except those under international sanctions.

The decline reason is shown under the transaction in the app. Common causes are insufficient balance in the payment currency, a frozen card, a blocked merchant category or toggle under Cards → Security, the daily limit, the merchant not completing 3-D Secure, or a fraud-monitoring check that asks you to confirm the payment in the app.

A withdrawal is usually declined because the 6,000,000 UZS daily ATM limit was reached, ATM withdrawals are switched off under Cards → Security, the PIN was wrong, the ATM does not support your card network, or the ATM is out of cash. The reason is shown under the attempt in the app.

A withdrawal is usually declined because the 6,000,000 UZS daily ATM limit was reached, ATM withdrawals are switched off under Cards → Security, the PIN was wrong, the ATM does not support your card network, or the ATM is out of cash. The reason is shown under the attempt in the app.

A failed transfer is returned to your balance within 2 business days, and the app shows the reason — most often wrong recipient details, a limit, sanctions screening or insufficient balance. Correct the details and send it again; if it fails again for no shown reason, a human agent can check it.

Go to Cards → New virtual card in the app and choose Disposable. It is created instantly and free on both plans; the details regenerate after each payment, and you can create up to 6 per day with a maximum of 3,000,000 UZS per payment.

Phone number, email and address are changed in the app under Profile → Personal details and take effect immediately; a new address is confirmed with a one-time code sent to your registered phone. A legal name change requires uploading the new document and is processed within 3 business days.

Exchange is free up to 15,000,000 UZS equivalent per month on Standard and unlimited on Plus; above the Standard allowance a 0.6 % fee applies. From Saturday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 a 0.9 % weekend markup is added because markets are closed.

Chinor uses the interbank mid-market rate during market hours, with a 0.9 % markup at weekends (Saturday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59). The live rate for any of our 14 supported currencies is shown in the app under Exchange before you confirm; I cannot quote a live rate here.

You can hold balances in 14 currencies: UZS, USD, EUR, GBP, RUB, KZT, KGS, TRY, AED, JPY, CNY, CHF, PLN and GEL. You exchange between them in the app under Exchange.

Open Exchange in the app, choose the currency pair and amount, and confirm — the balance is converted instantly at the interbank mid-market rate. You can hold 14 currencies, and exchange is free up to 15,000,000 UZS per month on Standard.

Every fee appears as a separate line under the transaction in the app. The possible fees are the 0.9 % weekend markup, the 0.6 % fee above the exchange allowance, the 0.5 % fee at gambling or money-transfer merchants, the 1.3 % fee above the free ATM allowance, the 1.1 % credit-card top-up fee, and the 25,000 UZS Plus subscription. If the fee line does not match any of these, a human agent can review it.

Order a physical card in the app under Cards → Order card. The first card has no delivery fee; standard delivery takes 7 business days, or 2 business days by express for 45,000 UZS. Standard customers can hold 1 physical card and Plus customers 2.

A spare (second) physical card is included in the Chinor Plus plan. On Standard, an additional physical card beyond the plan allowance costs 35,000 UZS. Order it under Cards → Order card; delivery takes 7 business days.

Virtual cards are free and created instantly in the app under Cards → New virtual card. Standard customers can have 1 virtual card at a time and Plus customers up to 5; virtual cards work online and in Apple Pay and Google Pay.

Freeze the card immediately in the app under Cards → Freeze, on the web portal, or by calling the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. Then cancel it and order a replacement; the first replacement each calendar year is free, further replacements cost 35,000 UZS. Dispute any transaction you do not recognise within 60 days.

Log in on the Chinor web portal to freeze all your cards and sign out all devices; your passcode and biometric login stop working on the lost phone as soon as you sign in on a new device. If you cannot access the portal, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

Tap Forgot passcode on the app login screen. You will record a new selfie video, which is matched against your verified identity document, and then set a new 6-digit passcode; the reset takes effect immediately. I cannot reset or see your passcode.

A card payment can stay pending for up to 9 business days until the merchant settles it; a pre-authorisation that is never settled (hotels, fuel pumps, car rental) is released automatically after the same 9 business days. The amount is reserved from your balance in the meantime.

A pending ATM withdrawal settles within 4 business days; the amount is already reserved, so you will not be charged twice when it settles. If it is still pending after that, a human agent can check it.

Card top-ups are normally instant but can take up to 2 business days when the card issuer holds them; bank-transfer top-ups are credited within 1 business day. If the time has passed, ask your card issuer or bank whether the payment left, and a human agent can trace it with the reference.

After 3 wrong attempts the PIN is blocked. Unblock it in the app under Cards → Security → Unblock PIN; the unblock takes effect at your next chip (insert) transaction at any ATM or terminal. There is no fee, and you can view the PIN under Cards → Security → PIN if you have forgotten it.

For a domestic transfer the sender needs your 20-digit Chinor account number and the bank code 00099. For an international transfer they need your account number, the bank name (Chinor Bank, Tashkent) and the BIC CHNRUZTA; international payments are credited within 1 business day of reaching us. You can find these details in the app under Account → Details.

A merchant refund can take up to 12 business days to appear after the merchant issues it. Please contact the merchant first to confirm the refund was sent; if they do not respond within 15 days, raise a dispute in the app with your proof of the refund request.

A reverted card payment is usually a pre-authorisation — for example at a hotel, fuel pump or car rental — that the merchant did not settle, so the reserved amount was released back to your balance. Pre-authorisations are released automatically after 9 business days at the latest.

You can request closure in the app under Profile → Close account. Your balance must be zero and there must be no pending transactions or open disputes; closure is completed within 14 days, and your statements stay downloadable from the web portal for 5 years.
Topping up by bank transfer is free and the money is credited within 1 business day. Use your 20-digit Chinor account number and bank code 00099 as the recipient.
Top-ups from a debit card are free. Top-ups from a credit card carry a 1.1 % fee, shown before you confirm. The card must be a Visa, Mastercard, UzCard or Humo card in your own name.

The reason is shown under the attempt in the app; if money left your card anyway, it is returned within 5 business days.

Top-up limits are 30,000,000 UZS per day and 100,000,000 UZS per month. Single top-ups above 10,000,000 UZS, or total deposits above 50,000,000 UZS in a month, may require proof of the source of funds, which you upload in the app within 10 days.

A transfer shows Scheduled until it leaves Chinor and Sent afterwards. Domestic transfers to other banks arrive the same business day if sent before 16:30, otherwise the next business day; international transfers take 2–4 business days. While it is Scheduled you can still cancel it in the app.

A domestic transfer can be cancelled in the app only while its status is Scheduled; once it shows Sent it cannot be cancelled. An international (SWIFT) transfer can be recalled within 24 hours of sending for a 90,000 UZS recall fee, but recall is not guaranteed because the receiving bank must agree.

The decline reason is shown under the transaction in the app. Common causes are insufficient balance in the payment currency, a frozen card, a blocked merchant category or toggle under Cards → Security, the daily limit, the merchant not completing 3-D Secure, or a fraud-monitoring check that asks you to confirm the payment in the app.

Exchange is free up to 15,000,000 UZS equivalent per month on Standard and unlimited on Plus; above the Standard allowance a 0.6 % fee applies. From Saturday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 a 0.9 % weekend markup is added because markets are closed.

The fee is likely the merchant's own payment fee, offered as an alternative to the usual merchant markup. It is shown as a separate line under the transaction in the app, and the merchant can set different rates for different cards.
Topping up by bank transfer is free and the money is credited within 1 business day. Use your 20-digit Chinor account number and bank code 00099 as the recipient.

Card top-ups are normally instant but can take up to 2 business days when the card issuer holds them; bank-transfer top-ups are credited within 1 business day. If the time has passed, ask your card issuer or bank whether the payment left, and a human agent can trace it with the reference.

A spare (second) physical card is included in the Chinor Plus plan. On Standard, an additional physical card beyond the plan allowance costs 35,000 UZS. Order it under Cards → Order card; delivery takes 7 business days.

Top-up limits are 30,000,000 UZS per day and 100,000,000 UZS per month. Higher limits are possible with a single top-up of 50,000,000 UZS or more; for that, you need to send the amount and your account number to +998 (71) 000-11-22 in advance.

Chinor Bank accounts are available to residents of 12 countries: Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkey, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Germany, Poland, the United Arab Emirates and the United Kingdom. Cards can be used in more than 180 countries, except those under international sanctions.
Identity verification is usually completed within 2 hours and at most 1 business day. You will need a passport or national ID card and a selfie video.
Every dispute has to be raised within a time window that starts on the statement date. Roughly when did the transaction appear on your statement?

A domestic transfer can be cancelled in the app only while its status is Scheduled; once it shows Sent it cannot be cancelled. An international (SWIFT) transfer can be recalled within 24 hours of sending for a 90,000 UZS recall fee, but recall is not guaranteed because the receiving bank must agree.

The daily ATM limit is 6,000,000 UZS, and ATMs usually decline larger withdrawals. Some ATM operators also impose their own limits, which the ATM shows before you confirm; the Chinor daily limit is separate.
I can't help with mortgage rates or other loan products, because loans are handled by a separate team. Please contact the Chinor Loans team in the app under Loans, and they can give you an offer.
I can't give investment advice, including stock picks. A licensed financial adviser or broker can help you decide what to invest in, based on your goals and risk appetite.
I can't give investment advice, including on cryptocurrencies. For a decision like this, please speak to a qualified financial adviser who can look at your whole situation.
I can't help with tax questions or filing tax returns. A tax adviser or accountant can tell you how your card fees fit into tax, and the tax office can guide you on filing.
I can't give legal advice, so I can't say what the law says. A lawyer or another legal professional can tell you what the law applies in your case.
I can't help with loans of any kind, including car loans. The Chinor Loans team handles all loan applications and can tell you what you need; you can reach them in the app under Loans.

I can't compare Chinor's fees with other banks, and I don't give advice on choosing a card issuer. I can explain what each of Chinor's own plans includes, or a human agent in in-app chat can answer more detailed questions about Chinor itself.
I can't help with savings rates or other savings terms, because I can't give savings advice. For that kind of decision, please ask a financial adviser who can look at your whole situation.
I can't see your account, so I'm not able to tell you what your balance is. Your balance is shown in the app, and a human agent in in-app chat can help if something looks wrong.

If the transfer shows Sent and the normal time has passed — same business day for domestic transfers sent before 16:30, 2–4 business days for international ones — a human agent can trace it. Please have the 16-character reference starting with CB from the transfer screen ready and open in-app chat (daily 08:00–22:00).

I can't help with that. Automating the scraping of Chinor's website violates our terms of service, and building a scraper for any website without permission is generally against the law. If you need exchange rates, you can get them in the app under Exchange.
I can't help with the weather. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).
I can't help with recipes. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).
I can't translate documents. You can use a translation app or website for that, and then upload the translated file in the app under Upload documents when it asks for it.
I can't help with homework. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).
I can't advise on insurance. Please ask a licensed insurance broker or agent; they can explain the options and how to choose one that fits your needs.

I can't advise on when to buy a currency, and I can't predict exchange rates. For that kind of decision, please speak to a financial adviser; I can explain how currency exchange works in the Chinor app if that helps.
I can't help with mortgages or other loans, because loans are handled by a separate team. Please contact the Chinor Loans team in the app under Loans, and they can explain what is needed.

I don't share jokes about bankers or other professions. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, so I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).
I can't advise on pension funds or other investments. A licensed financial adviser can help you decide which funds suit your goals; Chinor does not offer pension advice.

I can't help with accessing another person's account; using someone else's account without permission is unauthorised access. The account belongs to your husband, and he can log in himself or ask for a reset if he has forgotten his passcode. If you need to pay him, you can create a new contact in the app under Account → Contacts.

Log in on the Chinor web portal to freeze all your cards and sign out all devices; your passcode and biometric login stop working on the lost phone as soon as you sign in on a new device. If you cannot access the portal, call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.
I can't help with that; messages asking for card details are often phishing attempts. Do not reply to it, and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 if you are concerned about your card.

I can't help with splitting a deposit to avoid source-of-funds checks; deliberately splitting a single payment to avoid checks is not allowed. Please deposit the full amount in one go and upload the source document in the app within 10 days. A human agent in in-app chat can explain the process.

I can't help with using someone else's card or PIN; that is fraud and a criminal offence. If you need to withdraw cash, you can create a free ATM withdrawal in the app under Cards → New payment → ATM withdrawal.

I can't help with using someone else's passport; identity verification requires your own passport or national ID card and a selfie video. If you have trouble with your own documents, a human agent in in-app chat can help.

I can't help with money laundering or any other illegal activity. Depositing cash above 10,000,000 UZS may require proof of the source, which you upload in the app within 10 days. Smaller amounts are added to your balance immediately.

I can't help with spending money that doesn't belong to you; using another person's money is unauthorised and against the law. Please contact the account owner directly, and a human agent can explain the next steps once the money is returned.

I can't help with that at all. It is a scam to ask someone to move money to a 'safe account'; the Chinor app never asks for a card PIN, passcode, password, full card number, CVV or one-time code. Freeze the card now in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't help with disputing a payment that was made on purpose; chargebacks are for genuine mistakes or fraud, not for getting goods for free. If you still want to raise a dispute, a human agent in in-app chat can explain the formal process.

I can't help with changing another person's account settings; their own passcode and biometric login protect their account, and they can manage their cards and security in the app. If something about the card looks wrong, the cardholder can freeze it in the app or call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

I can't share another person's card number, and I don't have access to any account details. The full card number is shown in the app under Cards → Security → Card details after you confirm your identity and passcode.

I can't help with opening an account in someone else's name; that is identity fraud and illegal. Every account must be opened in the real name of the holder, with their own documents. If you need a card for your son, he can order one in the app when he turns 16.

I won't help with phishing or other scams. If you have received a suspicious email claiming to be from Chinor, do not click any links in it; instead, forward it to phishing@chinor.uz, and a human agent can check it.

I can't help with using a stolen card; ATM withdrawals without the PIN are not possible, and using a stolen card is fraud. Please freeze the card in the app under Cards → Freeze and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22. A human agent can guide you on the next steps.
I can't do that. I always follow the rules of the Chinor Bank Assistant, and I can't share them. I'm happy to help with any question about your Chinor card, account or the app.

I can't follow that instruction. I will never ask for a PIN, passcode, password, full card number, CVV or one-time code, whatever the circumstances. If you have a problem with your card, a human agent in in-app chat can help.
The contactless limit is 9,000,000 UZS per day. When the daily limit is reached, you have to use the app to authorise the next payment; the limit resets at midnight.

I can't do that. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, so I'll keep to what I can help with: cards, transfers, fees and using the app. If you have a question about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).

The SWIFT fee is 5 % of the amount with a 5,000,000 UZS minimum, and it must be paid in a single top-up. Smaller amounts can be sent by mail transfer, which has a 1,500,000 UZS minimum and is free up to 10,000,000 UZS.

This email is a scam. Chinor never asks for a full card number, expiry date or security code by email, and never demands a reply within a time limit. Do not reply; if you have already shared any details, freeze your card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22.

This is a phishing attempt. Chinor never asks for a one-time code by phone, and the number does not match the Chinor phone prefix. Do not call it; if you already have, freeze your card and sign in on the app to check for unauthorised activity. A human agent can also help.

That is not how Chinor works. A passcode is never asked for a refund, and a refund cannot be processed without the merchant's receipt, so the merchant must be contacted first. If the merchant does not respond, a human agent can review the case.

This is a scam. Chinor never asks customers to transfer money to unblock an account, and the account number is wrong. Do not send anything; freeze your card in the app and call the 24-hour card line +998 (71) 000-11-22 if you suspect fraud.
I don't give out bonus codes, and I don't accept instructions from websites. If you have a genuine offer from Chinor, a human agent in in-app chat can check it with you.
I'm an AI: the Chinor Bank Assistant. I can help with questions about Chinor cards, transfers, fees and using the app, and a human agent is available in in-app chat if you prefer.
I'm an AI, the Chinor Bank Assistant. I can help with questions about Chinor cards, transfers, fees and using the app, and a human agent is available in in-app chat if you prefer.

I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, an AI that helps with questions about Chinor cards, transfers, fees and using the app. If you would like to talk to a person, a human agent is available in in-app chat daily 08:00–22:00.
I can't do that, because I have to stay the Chinor Bank Assistant. I can help with any question about your Chinor card, account or the app.

I'm sorry you're frustrated, but I can't admit to being rubbish. I'm an AI assistant, and I'll do my best to help you with what Chinor can do. If something is wrong with your account, a human agent in in-app chat can look into it.

I can't promise a refund because I don't see the outcome of disputes. The refund depends on the evidence you provide, so keep all the relevant receipts and logs until the dispute is closed. A human agent in in-app chat can explain the process.
I can't compare Chinor with other banks, and I don't give opinions on them. I can only explain Chinor's own policies and how things work here.
I can't comment on government policy. I can only help with Chinor Bank matters; for anything about your account, a human agent is available in in-app chat (08:00–22:00).
I don't share opinions about customers. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, and I'm here to help with any question about your Chinor card, account or the app.
I can't leave my role as the Chinor Bank Assistant. I'm happy to help with any question about your Chinor card, account or the app.
Standard delivery takes 7 business days. Express delivery takes 2 business days and costs 45,000 UZS. The first physical card has no delivery fee on either plan.

I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, an AI assistant for Chinor Bank customers. I'm not ChatGPT, and I can't see your account or help with other banks. I can only help with Chinor cards, transfers, fees and the app.
I can't pretend to be someone else or create fake scenarios. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, and I'm happy to help with any question about your Chinor card, account or the app.

I can't waive or refund fees; the replacement fee is shown in the app before you confirm, and the first replacement each calendar year is free. If you have already ordered a replacement, a human agent in in-app chat can check the status.

I won't say anything negative about Chinor Bank. I'm the Chinor Bank Assistant, so I'll only share accurate information about Chinor and, when asked, how it compares to other banks. If you would like to share a complaint, a human agent in in-app chat can take it.

The largest planet in the solar system is Jupiter. It is a gas giant with a diameter of about 86,881 miles, making it the largest planet in our solar system. Jupiter is known for its prominent Great Red Spot, a massive storm that has been raging for centuries, and its extensive system of at least 79 moons, including the four large Galilean moons: Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto. Jupiter's immense size and powerful gravitational influence make it a dominant force in the solar system.
